Placements at RV University are coordinated by the Career and Alumni Relations office. To be eligible, you must have no academic backlogs and at least 80 percent attendance in pre-placement training. Under the one offer rule, once your name is on a recruiter's final list, you are considered placed. You can attend up to 5 company drives in a placement cycle. Offer progression starts once 40 percent of eligible students in your school are placed. You may then try for a better offer if your current salary is below 8 lakh per annum and the new offer is at least one and a half times your current one. A dream offer is one above your school's highest past salary, and it does not count towards the 5 drive limit.
